author: yakiniku_44
quote:
This game is divisive and it can clearly be reflected in the user review. It's not a GTA game, it's a modern Red Dead Redemption. The story is very slow, and Lucia is not easy to like as a protagnist and Jason has 0 personality, he is just a "Yes-mam" guy. Overall, the vybes feels really off in a series historicaly targeting the male audience. This time you have the play as a good boyfriend and you are forced to play a ton of side mission to please a very ungrateful girlfriend. While the city looks impressive and immersive (when it doesn't drop frames), but this is not enough to make a good game, the writing is just so bad that it distracts you. The characters are boring, they take themselves way too seriously compared to previous opus of the series. If it was released on PC, I would have asked for a refund.

First time I ever felt the need to write a game review just to warn people. First, they don't release it on PC and disc. Second, the game reviewer give the game a overall score of 99/100. Then after the release, the user review were locked... until they released their sales reports and told everyone they sold 33M copies. They knew their game would be controversial and would rub the fans the wrong way, they just wanted to get the news out for investors ASAP and silence the noise. They knew that on PC people would massively refund the game and if it was sold on disc, people would be reselling it for 10-15$ on marketplace. Nothing is only just a coincidence.
